title: Open Hat Lift
intro: Notice your open hat went quiet? On a 909 the closed hat and the open hat share one voice: whenever the closed hat fires, it cuts the open hat dead. Yours is sitting on step 15, right under the closed hat you just added. Move it to step 16 — clear it, then place it on the last step — and it rings out over the turnaround, pulling the loop into the next bar.
